title: Open December with Exact Calendar Coverage
teaser: The final month of the year must contain all thirty-one canonical days.
full_text: Build December 2035 from December 1 through December 31 and verify date order plus locale values match the canonical contract.

title: Make Leap-Second Handling Explicit
teaser: Time-scale conversion must not depend on a hidden assumption.
full_text: Convert a known leap-second boundary fixture and verify the provider follows the documented UTC behavior deterministically.

title: Mark Results When UT1 Data Is Missing
teaser: A date without EOP coverage must not appear to have full precision.
full_text: Calculate a fixture lacking a UT1 record and verify the result manifest exposes degraded precision or an unsupported state explicitly.

title: Hash Natal Snapshots with Calculation Parameters
teaser: Identical-looking output from different settings must remain distinguishable.
full_text: Change house system orb policy ephemeris version and birth input across fixtures and verify snapshot hashes change accordingly.

title: Keep Backup Filenames Independent of UI Language
teaser: Restore discovery should not break when localization changes.
full_text: Create backups under Turkish and English locales and verify the machine-readable extension plus manifest contract remain identical.

title: Reload Counts After Restore Rollback
teaser: The UI must not retain stale success totals after a failed transaction.
full_text: Trigger a restore failure mid-transaction and verify record counts plus preview state return to the actual rolled-back database state.

title: Match PDF Outline Targets to Section Pages
teaser: Table-of-contents links must land on the correct report sections.
full_text: Build a multi-section report and verify outline bookmarks resolve to the starting page of their corresponding sections.

title: Do Not Expose Domain IDs as Translation Fallback
teaser: Missing localized text must never reveal internal technical keys.
full_text: Create a fixture with a missing localized label and verify the UI uses the approved fallback without exposing the stable domain ID.

title: Keep Rewarded Unlock Separate from Lifetime PRO
teaser: Temporary access must not modify permanent ownership records.
full_text: Grant a rewarded entitlement let it expire and verify lifetime ownership fields remain completely unchanged.

title: Constrain Export Paths to the App Sandbox
teaser: User-controlled filenames must not enable writes outside approved storage.
full_text: Submit traversal and absolute-path filename fixtures and verify storage canonicalization never escapes the permitted export directory.

title: Test Foreign-Key Deletion Policy Explicitly
teaser: Child-record behavior must not depend on accidental database defaults.
full_text: Delete a profile with related notes and consultations and verify cascade restrict or tombstone behavior matches the schema contract.

title: Provide Accessible Summaries for Visual Charts
teaser: A graphical chart cannot be the only representation of important information.
full_text: Inspect the natal chart through the semantics tree and verify key placements plus aspect information have an accessible textual summary.

title: Honor Reduced-Motion Preferences in Transitions
teaser: Users requesting less motion should not receive full animation on critical flows.
full_text: Enable reduced motion and verify onboarding chart transitions plus modal animations switch to the contracted reduced behavior.

title: Key Location Cache by Coordinates and Dataset Version
teaser: Same-named places must not collide because of a weak cache key.
full_text: Query fixtures sharing a city name but using different coordinates and dataset versions and verify no incorrect cache reuse occurs.

title: Preserve User Choice for Ambiguous DST Times
teaser: A repeated wall time must remember which offset occurrence was selected.
full_text: Calculate both folds of a fall-back overlap and verify the chosen fold identity survives persistence and reload.

title: Regression-Lock Ephemeris Provider Changes
teaser: Provider updates must not introduce silent calculation drift.
full_text: Run approved natal golden fixtures against the updated provider and fail the calculation gate for any difference beyond documented tolerance.

title: Verify House Cusp Ordering Across Zodiac Wrap
teaser: Crossing from 359 degrees to 0 degrees must not scramble house sequence.
full_text: Generate a cusp-wrap fixture and verify all twelve houses preserve circular zodiac order after canonical normalization.

title: Test Personal-Year Transition Policy at Birthday Boundaries
teaser: Numerology period changes must follow one explicit rule.
full_text: Calculate fixtures for the day before the birthday the birthday itself and the day after and verify results match the configured transition policy.

title: Validate Ten Gods with Element and Polarity
teaser: Element matching alone is insufficient for a correct relationship identity.
full_text: Calculate stem pairs with different yin-yang combinations and verify Ten Gods mapping applies both element and polarity rules.

title: Track License-File Hashes in the Asset Manifest
teaser: Redistribution evidence must remain versioned alongside runtime assets.
full_text: Validate a font or tarot test asset and fail the asset gate when license path checksum or provenance is missing.

title: Allow Core First Launch in Airplane Mode
teaser: Basic local features must not require network access to start.
full_text: Open a clean-install fixture in airplane mode and verify onboarding profile creation and local calculation flows remain usable.

title: Resolve Concurrent Writes Deterministically
teaser: Near-simultaneous updates to one record must not lose data silently.
full_text: Run two concurrent update fixtures and verify revision or transaction policy returns the documented deterministic conflict result.

title: Measure Peak Memory During Long PDF Generation
teaser: A fifty-page report has a different resource profile from a tiny sample.
full_text: Generate a long professional report in release profile and verify peak memory remains below the documented performance budget.

title: Do Not Copy Sensitive Data to Clipboard Automatically
teaser: Convenience features must not bypass privacy boundaries.
full_text: Inspect copy actions on client and calculation screens and verify sensitive fields reach the clipboard only after an explicit user action.

title: Reopen Generated PDFs with an Independent Parser
teaser: Producing bytes alone is not sufficient evidence of a valid report.
full_text: Open the final PDF fixture with an independent parser and verify page count outline text objects and document closure are structurally valid.

title: Lock CSV Encoding to UTF-8
teaser: Unicode content must not depend on the host system locale.
full_text: Export Turkish characters and additional Unicode symbols then decode as UTF-8 and verify the exact text survives round trip.

title: Keep Session Tokens Out of Persistent Logs
teaser: Temporary authorization material must never remain on disk.
full_text: Trigger entitlement and authentication error fixtures then scan persistent logs and verify no token-like secrets are present.

title: Reapply Locale Changes After Resume
teaser: A language preference changed while backgrounded must not produce mixed-language UI.
full_text: Change locale while the app is backgrounded then resume and verify all visible user-facing text on the current route resolves in the new locale.

title: Check December Exact Duplicates Against Full History
teaser: Year-end content must not repeat earlier published text.
full_text: Compare December English titles teasers and full messages against the entire English catalog from 2026 onward and fail on exact matches.

title: Review Year-End Near-Duplicate Candidates
teaser: Minor rewording must not qualify automatically as new editorial content.
full_text: Run December English records through historical similarity audit and require review for every candidate above the contracted threshold.

title: Close the 2035 Editorial Boundary from Main Evidence
teaser: The next year should begin only after committed year-end shards are verified.
full_text: Reload committed Turkish and English shards through the end of 2035 verify contiguous counts and record January 1 2036 as the next editorial start.
